summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K solely to register 6,351 shares of common stock for resale by stockholders who received these shares in a prior acquisition of World View Enterprises Inc. The filing includes a legal opinion regarding the shares' legality. There are no new transaction details, price, premium, or board recommendation. The filing is a routine resale registration under an existing S-3ASR shelf, not a special situation event.
